questions.text: Overall, how satisfied were you with your experience with J Merrill One?
Did you feel heard and understood?
Was it clear where to go for what you needed?
How would you rate our communication?
How easy was it to work with us?
How likely are you to recommend J Merrill One?
Which part of J Merrill best describes your experience?
questions.note: Context for analysis only; respondent is not redirected.

questions.text: What could we do better or what else would you like us to know?
questions.note: Consolidated improvement and open feedback to keep the survey concise.

questions.text: May we contact you about using part of your feedback as a testimonial?
questions.note: Permission to contact only, not publication approval.

human_first_result: PASS - concise, plain-language, no internal routing/system terminology.
